title: Add suggested model metadata to tasks
description: Extend the canonical task model with an optional free-form model field that records the suggested model for completing the task. Support --model on task create and task update/edit, persist it in flat-file JSON, and include it in human and JSON output. Update the wtp help command, wtp schema output, README, and skills/task-management/skill.md with model guidance and examples. Preserve backward compatibility for existing task files and add validation plus provider and CLI tests, including assertions that help and schema advertise --model.

comments.author: Codex
comments.message: Claimed task; extending the canonical model, CLI create/update/edit paths, output, documentation, and tests for optional suggested-model metadata.
